# Hazine

Hazine is a guided, interactive demonstration of a provenance-first intelligence system for commodities trader Ezgi.

## Core model

Hazine collects market information, connects it to people, evidence, prior thinking, and decisions, then surfaces the right memory when the present moment makes it relevant.

## Intelligence taxonomy

- FACT
- SIGNAL
- INTERPRETATION
- HYPOTHESIS
- STRATEGY

## Product surfaces

The desktop application is the treasury. The agent plugin is the doorway into that same shared intelligence layer.
